notebooks.title: 感应灯联合表与条件反转

cells.code:
p,t,f=sp.Rational(1,100),sp.Rational(9,10),sp.Rational(1,20)
joint=[p*t,p*(1-t),(1-p)*f,(1-p)*(1-f)]
bell=joint[0]+joint[2]
print('四格联合概率:',joint,'合计:',sum(joint))
print('万次期望四格:',[v*10000 for v in joint])
print('行合计/列合计:',[100,9900],[bell*10000,(1-bell)*10000])
print('亮灯概率/后验/小数:',bell,joint[0]/bell,sp.N(joint[0]/bell,12))
print('D并B:',p+bell-joint[0])
p2=sp.Rational(1,10)
print('先验10%后验:',p2*t/(p2*t+(1-p2)*f))
print('独立检验P交集与P乘积:',joint[0],p*bell)
print('相同亮灯概率时后验:',p*sp.Rational(1,5)/(p*sp.Rational(1,5)+(1-p)*sp.Rational(1,5)))

notebooks.title: 离散CDF与连续面积
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
x=sp.symbols('x', real=True)

cells.code:
values=[-1,0,1]
weights=[sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4)]
for threshold in [-2,-1,sp.Rational(-1,2),0,sp.Rational(1,2),1,2]:
    print('阈值/CDF:',threshold,sum(w for v,w in zip(values,weights) if v<=threshold))
print('离散P等于0/P小于等于0:',weights[1],sum(w for v,w in zip(values,weights) if v<=0))
print('均匀密度2的总面积/四分之一内概率:',sp.integrate(2,(x,0,sp.Rational(1,2))),sp.integrate(2,(x,0,sp.Rational(1,4))))
print('连续单点积分:',sp.integrate(2,(x,sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(1,4))))

vals=[-1,0,1]
probs=[sp.Rational(1,4),sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(1,4)]
mu=sum(v*p for v,p in zip(vals,probs))
second=sum(v*v*p for v,p in zip(vals,probs))
variance=second-mu*mu
print('误差均值/二阶矩/方差/标准差:',mu,second,variance,sp.sqrt(variance),sp.N(sp.sqrt(variance),12))
y=[2*v+3 for v in vals]
my=sum(v*p for v,p in zip(y,probs))
print('线性变换均值/方差:',my,sum((v-my)**2*p for v,p in zip(y,probs)))
u=vals
EU=sum(u)/sp.Integer(3)
EV=sum(v*v for v in u)/sp.Integer(3)
EUV=sum(v**3 for v in u)/sp.Integer(3)
cov=EUV-EU*EV
print('U均值/V均值/UV均值/协方差:',EU,EV,EUV,cov)
print('VarU/VarV:',sum(v*v for v in u)/sp.Integer(3)-EU**2,sum(v**4 for v in u)/sp.Integer(3)-EV**2)
print('P(U0且V0)/边缘乘积:',sp.Rational(1,3),sp.Rational(1,9))

notebooks.title: 伯努利二项与正态面积
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import quad
import math

cells.code:
p=sp.Rational(1,5)
n=5
pmf=[sp.binomial(n,k)*p**k*(1-p)**(n-k) for k in range(n+1)]
print('伯努利均值/方差:',p,p*(1-p))
print('二项概率表:',pmf,'总和:',sum(pmf))
print('P0/P1/P至少1:',sp.N(pmf[0],10),sp.N(pmf[1],10),sp.N(1-pmf[0],10))
print('二项均值/方差:',sum(k*v for k,v in enumerate(pmf)),sum((k-1)**2*v for k,v in enumerate(pmf)))
sigma=2.0
pdf=lambda x:math.exp(-x*x/(2*sigma*sigma))/(sigma*math.sqrt(2*math.pi))
area,error=quad(pdf,-2,2,epsabs=1e-12,epsrel=1e-12)
print('正态中心密度/区间概率/积分误差估计:',pdf(0),area,error)

sample=list(map(sp.Integer,[-1,0,0,1]))
n=len(sample)
mean=sum(sample)/n
ss=sum((v-mean)**2 for v in sample)
print('样本数/均值/平方和:',n,mean,ss)
print('样本方差n-1/平均平方偏差n:',ss/(n-1),ss/n)
print('教学总体方差:',sp.Rational(1,2))

notebooks.title: 独立平均与共同误差
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from itertools import product

cells.code:
print('sigma2平均标准差:',[(n,sp.Rational(2)/sp.sqrt(n)) for n in [1,4,16,100]])
print('离散表n100门限1/2的Chebyshev界:',sp.Rational(1,2)/(100*sp.Rational(1,2)**2))
rows=[]
for config in product([-1,1],repeat=5):
    common,*noise=config
    readings=[sp.Integer(common+v) for v in noise]
    rows.append((readings,sum(readings)/4))
means=[avg for _,avg in rows]
print('枚举配置数/平均的均值/方差:',len(rows),sum(means)/len(rows),sum(v*v for v in means)/len(rows))
print('单次方差/两次协方差:',sum(r[0]**2 for r,_ in rows)/len(rows),sum(r[0]*r[1] for r,_ in rows)/len(rows))
print('错误独立假设下的方差:',sp.Rational(2,4),'真实极限方差:',1)

notebooks.title: 六题答案复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
from scipy.integrate import quad
import math

cells.code:
p,t,f=sp.Rational(1,100),sp.Rational(9,10),sp.Rational(1,20)
bell=p*t+(1-p)*f
print('题1:',bell,p*t/bell,sp.Rational(1,10)*t/(sp.Rational(1,10)*t+sp.Rational(9,10)*f))
print('题2互斥交集/独立所需乘积/无信息后验:',0,sp.Rational(1,4),p)
print('题3 P0/CDF0/均值/方差/标准差:',sp.Rational(1,2),sp.Rational(3,4),0,sp.Rational(1,2),1/sp.sqrt(2))
print('题3均匀密度/面积/半区间概率:',2,1,sp.Rational(1,2))
print('题4 Y均值/方差:',3,2,'U,V协方差0但交集1/3不等于1/9')
print('题5:',1-sp.Rational(4,5)**5,sp.N(1-sp.Rational(4,5)**5,10),1,sp.Rational(4,5))
pdf=lambda x:math.exp(-x*x/8)/(2*math.sqrt(2*math.pi))
print('题5正态sigma/中心密度/概率:',2,pdf(0),quad(pdf,-2,2,epsabs=1e-12,epsrel=1e-12)[0])
print('题6样本均值/样本方差/独立平均标准差/共同平均方差:',0,sp.Rational(2,3),1,sp.Rational(5,4))
